sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase pages: the wiki's side bar moves to the right, as on MusicBrainz (new setting "Show the Brucebase side bar on the right", on by default), and gets the MusicBrainz sidebar's collapse handle, starting hidden (the MusicBrainz settings "Collabsable sidebar" and "Start with sidebar collapsed" apply). Next to a wide table it stays at the window's right edge. On the left it collapses to the left.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase start page (brucebase.wikidot.com): a "Show all events of all years" button after the "Brucebase — Home" heading reads every year page linked under Gig Pages (1949-64, 1965, …) into one table with the year-page columns of WIP.1, at the top of the start page. Same switch as the year pages (sa_bb_year_pages).

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase year table (WIP.1): on the real pages the Date column showed blank, header and all, and the wiki's side bar was cut off where the table began. The sticky page headers masked the gutter left of a sticky column in the page colour, and on Brucebase that gutter is the side bar. Date is now the first column and the one that stays in view when scrolling sideways, and Brucebase tables (the song list too) dock at the window edge without a mask.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase year pages (brucebase.wikidot.com/1975, …, /2026, and /1949-64): a new "Events" button turns the year's shows, sessions, rehearsals, interviews and cancelled dates into one filterable, sortable table, one row per entry — Date (with DD/MM/YYYY/Day/Month; a day or month the wiki gives as 00 is left out), Type, Venue (linked to the entry's page), City, State, Country, Tour (from the wiki's tour and era boxes), Soundcheck and Setlist one song per row (other labelled sets such as "Pre-show:" stay in Setlist, tagged with their label), Set note, Notes (the description with its links; song links get the song preview), Media (the wiki's own icons, filterable by name) and Info wanted. Off by default: new setting "Enable on the Brucebase year pages (event lists)" (sa_bb_year_pages), which needs the Brucebase switch on too.
